---
title: Potatoes and Mussels
id: MAR-0095
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 70
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 400 g mussels
- 220 g rice
- 2 onion
- 400 g cherry tomatoes
- 20 g parsley
- 1 garlic clove
- 400 g potato
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Peel the potatoes, wash them and then cut them into slices.
2. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half.
3. Crush the garlic clove and peel it.
4. Wash the parsley, remove the stems and chop it with the garlic.
5. Peel and slice the onions.
6. Scrape the mussels, remove the byssus, open them with a knife, removing the empty shell as you go, and strain their liquid.
7. Grease a large ovenproof pan with a tablespoon of oil.
8. Arrange a first layer of onions on the bottom, sprinkle over part of the garlic and parsley mixture, then add a layer with half of the cherry tomatoes, then half of the potatoes, slightly overlapping them to form another layer, season with salt and pepper.
9. Spread the rice on the surface, then the mussels and the rest of the cherry tomatoes, sprinkle with the parsley mixture and continue with the remaining potatoes.
10. Season with salt and pepper, then add to the mussel liquid the necessary water to obtain 7 dl (or in any case a quantity sufficient to cover the preparation).
11. Finish with the remaining oil, put the lid on the pan and bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes.
12. Remove the lid and continue cooking for about 15-20 minutes, adding boiling water if necessary.
